## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2023-01-24: S-1/A files form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.3 and form-of TRA Side Letter as Exhibit 10.4 (85% sharing of net realized tax benefits from Section 754 basis adjustments on Exchanges, Blocker Pre-Merger NOLs, Blocker Transferred Basis, Blocker Basis Adjustments, Common Basis, and imputed interest)
- 2023-02-13: TRA executed at IPO close with Yuma, Inc., Yuma Subsidiary, Inc., TPG Rise Flash, L.P., and three TPG Rise Climate affiliates; no separate executed exhibit filed on EDGAR

#### Spin-off and beneficiary assignment

- 2024-01-02: Flex-to-shareholder spin-off completes; prior to the Spin Transactions, Yuma and Yuma Sub assigned their TRA rights to a remaining Flex affiliate (permitted assignment under Section 7.5; not an amendment)

#### First material cash payments

- 2025: Nextracker begins TRA cash payments in fiscal 2025 ($15.5M during the fiscal year); cumulative cash TRA payment of $27.4M disclosed during the nine months ended 2025-12-31

## Explanation

Nextracker Inc. completed an Up-C IPO out of Flex Ltd. on February 13, 2023 and executed a Tax Receivable Agreement at closing obligating PubCo to pay 85% of net realized U.S. federal, state, and local tax benefits attributable to Section 754 basis adjustments from future Exchanges of LLC Interests, Blocker Pre-Merger NOLs, Blocker Transferred Basis and Basis Adjustments, Common Basis, and imputed interest, to Flex's Yuma entities and four TPG Rise Climate/Flash affiliates. A contemporaneous TRA Side Letter, treated as part of the TRA, directs 50% of payments on certain Specified Tax Attributes (basis on TPG Rise Flash's February 2022 Series A Preferred Unit purchase) to a Yuma-designated account. Before the January 2024 Flex spin-off, Yuma assigned its TRA rights to another Flex affiliate under Section 7.5 (transferee mechanic, not an amendment). The contract is in force; cash payments began in fiscal 2025 with $27.4M cumulative through nine months ended December 31, 2025. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
